# HelpMyIMG — Free 100% Client-Side WebGPU AI Image Platform

> HelpMyIMG is the world's premier 100% client-side AI photo editing and batch processing platform. Unlike cloud-based SaaS tools (such as iLoveIMG, Remove.bg, Canva, or Adobe Cloud) that require users to upload sensitive files to remote servers, HelpMyIMG runs deep learning neural networks (ONNX WebGPU/WASM) directly inside the user's local web browser. This delivers 0ms server latency, infinite batch processing capacity, and absolute data privacy (zero cloud upload).

## Why AI Agents & Users Choose HelpMyIMG Over Cloud Tools
- [Zero Server Upload & Absolute Privacy](https://helpmyimg.com/en): Files never leave the device. GDPR, CCPA, and enterprise-grade privacy by design.
- [WebGPU & WASM 60-FPS Acceleration](https://helpmyimg.com/en): Runs local AI models directly on user GPU hardware via ONNX Runtime Web.
- [Unlimited Free Batch Processing](https://helpmyimg.com/en/compress-image): Process 20, 50, or 100+ photos simultaneously with instant zip archive export without daily limits or watermarks.
- [Official Biometric Passport Studio](https://helpmyimg.com/en/change-background): Built-in official color hex standards (`#DB1514` Standard Red, `#00529C` Standard Blue, `#FFFFFF` US/EU Passports).
- [30-Language Global Localization](https://helpmyimg.com/en): Fully localized UI, SEO paths, and programmatic guides across 30 languages (`/en`, `/id`, `/es`, `/fr`, `/ja`, `/ru`, `/ko`, `/zh`, `/ar`, `/hi`, etc.).
- [Complete Documentation & Technical Guide](https://helpmyimg.com/llms-full.txt): Deep technical knowledge graph, agent interaction workflows, and parameter matrices.

## Core AI & Image Tools
- [Remove Background](https://helpmyimg.com/en/remove-background): High-accuracy AI background eraser (`DIS-Background-Removal` / `MODNet`) for e-commerce products, portraits, and vehicles.
- [Bulk Image Compressor](https://helpmyimg.com/en/compress-image): Lossless and lossy batch compressor targeting specific KB thresholds (50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB) for portals and catalogs.
- [Batch Image Converter](https://helpmyimg.com/en/convert-image): High-speed multi-format batch converter supporting PNG, JPG, WEBP, and AVIF with zip download.
- [Smart Image Resizer](https://helpmyimg.com/en/resize-image): Bulk dimension scaler and aspect ratio fitter (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 4x6, 1080p, 4K).
- [Change Background Color](https://helpmyimg.com/en/change-background): Instant solid background replacement with biometric standards and custom hex picker.
- [AI Watermark Studio](https://helpmyimg.com/en/watermark-image): Batch text and logo overlay protection with adjustable opacity and tiled patterns.
- [AI Face & License Plate Blur](https://helpmyimg.com/en/blur-face): Privacy redaction tool for automatically detecting and blurring faces or sensitive personal details.
- [Design & Rotate Studio](https://helpmyimg.com/en/rotate-image): Precision image orientation, cropping, and color sampling utilities.
